title: RuntimeApprovalRequest
description: HTTP/runtime request body for recording action-bound approval evidence through the daemon boundary. The session id and action id are path parameters for /v1/sessions/<session-id>/actions/<action-id>/approval.

grant_id.description: Grant being approved. It must be one of the action manifest's required grants and must have been issued in the session.

reviewer_id.description: Reviewer identity to bind into ApprovalEvidence. Policy admission later checks this against the grant approval requirement.

review_id.description: Optional stable review id. When omitted or blank, the daemon derives review-<action-id>-<grant-id>.

approved_at.description: Optional approval timestamp. It must not be in the future relative to the daemon append time.

readmit.description: When true, the daemon immediately re-runs admission for the same manifest after appending the approval.
